historical_record.description: The academic building of Abraham Lincoln High School was built here with Public Works Administration funding, at a cost of $750,000, and dedicated on 22 September 1940 with 100 classrooms, a shops complex and a library. Timothy Pflueger led the design, assisted by Frederick H. Meyer, Wilbur Peugh and Martin J. Rist, in the Late Moderne style; the gymnasium and auditorium in the same plan waited until after the Second World War.
Abraham Lincoln School, designed by architect Frederick H. Meyer.
Abraham Lincoln High School, designed by Edward L. Frick with his firm Weilhe, Frick & Kruse.
Photographed, showing the Lincoln High School.
Recommended for city landmark designation in 2023, on historical, aesthetic and artistic grounds.
